hook: LEAK AT 7 AM.|DAM BREACHED BY NOON.
photo_credit: Photo: Teton Dam Flood - Newdale (IDAHO-L-0010), 5 June 1976, by Roberts — WaterArchives.org, CC BY-SA 2.0 (via Wikimedia Commons)

scenes.say: June 1976. Idaho. The Teton Dam gives way.
Water found open joints in the rock below. The core's silt washes out easily, and no filter held it back. The water cut a pipe straight through.
The flood killed at least eleven people.

comment: Teton had no filters to make its leaks harmless. On rock this cracked, would you have filled it? The full step-by-step breakdown is on the channel.
